_comment: Copy this to .claude/settings.json and adjust paths. Hooks are deterministic (run 100% of the time); CLAUDE.md is advisory (~80%). Anything that MUST happen every time belongs here, not in CLAUDE.md.

permissions._comment: Default-deny posture. Allow the safe, frequent commands so the human isn't clicking Allow every few seconds. Keep destructive and network commands gated.

hooks._comment: PostToolUse hooks run after a file is written. These keep the tree always-formatted and catch type errors immediately, so Claude sees a clean diff and real errors fast.

hooks.command: if echo "$CLAUDE_FILE_PATH" | grep -qE '\.(ts|tsx)$'; then npx prettier --write "$CLAUDE_FILE_PATH" && npx eslint --fix "$CLAUDE_FILE_PATH"; fi
if echo "$CLAUDE_FILE_PATH" | grep -qE '\.rs$'; then cargo fmt -- "$CLAUDE_FILE_PATH"; fi

Stop._comment: When Claude finishes a turn, run a fast typecheck so type errors never linger silently. Not the full test suite (too slow); just compile-level checks.

hooks.command: npm run check --silent || echo 'WARNING: npm run check failed — there are type/lint errors in the tree.'

PreToolUse._comment: Block any write that would add a network call into a PDF operation file. A crude guard, but offline-first is a hard constraint.

hooks.command: if echo "$CLAUDE_FILE_PATH" | grep -qE 'src-tauri/src/(pdf|page|convert)/' && grep -qE '(reqwest|fetch\(|http://|https://)' "$CLAUDE_FILE_PATH" 2>/dev/null; then echo 'BLOCKED: network call detected in a PDF operation file. Offline-first is a hard constraint (see docs/01_VISION.md).' && exit 1; fi

env._comment: Project-specific environment. Adjust for your machine.
